note: p99.99 baselines per profile, read by scripts/bench-compare.py; a profile's entry is set from that runner's own run with --update (ADR 0015, docs/how-to/run-the-bench.md). bench-linux is the dedicated bench host, the only runner the gate fails on (ADR 0016, docs/how-to/set-up-a-bench-host.md); bench-linux-unchecked is the same host with the data-plane checks built out (just bench-unchecked). The shared runners report and are not compared. Each entry's clock_step_ns is the step of the host's clock, the floor under the 5 percent rule; the comparison takes the smaller of it and the result's step (ADR 0029).
